decisions.reason: The email-to-SMS gateway builds directly on the firm's core hosted messaging and email expertise, so the firm can interpret early usage data and refine the product with its own R&D at low cost, and dropping it this soon after launch would be premature.

The SMS-to-email gateway draws on the same messaging infrastructure and know-how, though its overlap with the withdrawn inbound SMS API makes it slightly more vulnerable; it still complements the firm's integrated communication platform and is worth keeping while the firm learns from its results.
